svg.title: Right shoulder joint relationships, anterior view
svg.desc: Right shoulder from the front. The humerus is at the viewer's left; its head points medially (viewer's right) into the glenoid cavity of the scapula. Glenohumeral ligaments strengthen the front of the capsule; the acromioclavicular ligament joins clavicle and acromion above. Patient right is on the viewer's left.
